environment.meaning: Neutral analytical visibility defaults, not reconstructed Anubis lighting.

fov_horizontal_deg.reason: Used only when no canonical FOV exists; never written to Replay.

eye_height_world_units.reason: Existing renderer default for view preparation; never written to Replay.

dynamic_objects.policy: Do not invent geometry. Downgrade geometry-dependent conclusions when omitted dynamics are material.

floors.policy: Use canonical world Z for placement but do not assign named floors.

fallback_visibility.map_unavailable: Render no map geometry; show an explicit unavailable state. Diagnostic reference bounds may be used only in isolated tests.
